cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You rang to cancel dinner instead of just not coming. Remember when I taught you that? You still don't want to hurt me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to think how it lands. After three cancellations, my feelings still matter to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the considerate answer I've been teaching you. I'll make other plans. You're looking after my evenings now; we haven't lost that.
